narrative: The spilled silver heap beside the opened boxes, Cuthbert's hand still on a lid.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not touch the lid.

entities.name: Cuthbert Burbage
entities.context: His hand is the one in the picture.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: The baize under the silver is his. He is not the hand.

entities.name: the boxes
entities.context: In photo: The silver, and a hand on a lid
